Name: One person, one record
Statement: Every employee, contingent worker and position has one authoritative record.
Rationale: Removes conflicting headcount and duplicate entry.
Implications: Employee Central is the system of record; legacy tools are retired.

Name: Process before tool
Statement: Agree the standard process first, then configure; vary only where law or business needs it.
Rationale: Keeps the core clean and upgradeable.
Implications: Local variants are configuration and logged as decisions.

Name: Position drives headcount
Statement: Hiring and cost follow approved positions.
Rationale: Gives Finance and HR one control point.
Implications: No hire without an approved position or approved exception.

Name: People decide
Statement: Automation and AI advise; named people decide changes to pay, status and employment.

Name: Personal data held in trust
Statement: Collect the minimum, with notice and purpose; keep only as long as needed.
Implications: Retention by region table; deletion is tested.

Name: Canonical workforce model
Statement: Partners map to OmniVerse entities and codes; partner formats stay in adapters.
Implications: One mapping table set per partner.

Name: Provider detail stays with the provider
Statement: Sensitive detail held by a provider is not copied; the hub keeps status and reference.

Name: Every entity has an owner and steward
Statement: Named roles own definitions, quality and access.

Name: Hub and spokes
Statement: One core HR hub; partners attach to the hub through the integration hub, never to each other.

Name: Standard first, then configure, then extend
Statement: Use standard capability first; extend on the integration or extension layer only after fit-to-standard.

Name: Capability interface, replaceable partner
Statement: Each category is consumed through a defined interface and adapter.
Implications: Contract tests and exit plans per category.

Name: Event-driven by default
Statement: Changes flow as signed events; batch only for bulk and reporting.
Implications: Replay and reconciliation are built in.

Name: Open standards
Statement: REST, OData, OAuth 2.0, SAML or OIDC, SCIM and signed events.
Implications: Standards register is enforced at review.

Name: Zero trust for partners
Statement: Scoped, rotatable credentials, least privilege and full logging.
Rationale: Limits damage from any one partner.
Implications: Vault and audit log are mandatory.

Name: Residency by design
Statement: Data stays in approved regions; processing locations are recorded.
Implications: Region map drives hosting and routing.

Name: Observable and exit-ready
Statement: Every integration is monitored; every partner has a tested exit.
